# CHANGES — Map/Set/Tuple structural Type variants

## Confirmations
- cargo test: **24/24** passed (19 prior + 5 new Map/Set/Tuple tests)
- cargo clippy pedantic: clean
- scripts/manual-test.sh: 14/14 pairs still pass (verified during development)
- Did NOT add Type::InlineStruct / Type::InlineEnum
- Classification logic in diff_types/diff_fields/classify_field unchanged

## TypeNode variants STILL mapping to Type::Generic
1. **Struct (inline as field type)** / **Enum (inline as field type)** — residual known gap.
   Comment in convert_type:
   > Residual known gap: inline struct/enum used *as a field type*
   > (anonymous composite). Top-level account data / definedTypes already
   > promote to TypeDef via convert_defined_type / account_as_type_def.
   > Representing anonymous inlines needs Type::InlineStruct/InlineEnum
   > (or synthetic Defined names) — left Generic until that lands. Real
   > Vixen Codama IDLs almost always Link to definedTypes instead.
2. **NumberFormat::F32 / F64 / ShortU16** — not standard Anchor/Borsh integer
   scalars in our Type enum; opaque by design.

Map, Set, and Tuple no longer fall through to Generic.
